abstract:
We study the Haydys–Witten (HW) equations for $SU(2)$ on $\mathbb R_s	imes S^3_r	imes(0,L)$ with Nahm poles at both ends, near the Anderson–Henningson fold $L=\pi r$, in the complete gauge-fixed deformation space. By [20], the static operator at the fold has kernel $\mathbb R\zeta\oplus\mathcal K$, with $\mathcal K\cong\mathbb R^4$ a spin-½ multiplet, and the AH instanton has index $-3$.
(A) We construct a five-dimensional, parameter-dependent centre manifold that contains every small bounded solution. It is equivariant under $SO(4)=(SU(2)_L	imes SU(2)_{m diag})/\pm1$, acting on $\mathcal K$ as on $\mathbb R^4$. It is also reversible under a new reversor $R$, built from $(s,y,q)\mapsto(-s,L-y, ar q)$ and the gauge transformation $q\mapsto ar q$.
(B) Hence the reduced field is $\dot x=g(x^2,|w|^2, ar
u)$, $\dot w=x\,	ilde h(x^2,|w|^2, ar
u)\,w$, where $ ar
u=L^2/r^2-\pi^2$. In the units of [17, 18, 20], $g=	frac56x^2-	frac43 ar
u-	frac58|w|^2+O_4$ and $	ilde h=-	frac54+O_2$. An exact computation of the second-order centre-manifold terms shows that all weighted-cubic coefficients vanish: the coefficients of $|w|^4$, $ ar
u|w|^2$ and $x^2|w|^2$ in the reduced potential are $0$.
(C) For $-\delta< ar
u<0$ the KW solutions near the fold form exactly one orbit $\mathcal S_{ ar
u}\cong S^3$: $x=0$ and $|w|^2=-	frac{32}{15} ar
u+O( ar
u^2)$. These solutions are not left-invariant. Their stabiliser is the $SO(3)$ of isometries fixing a point of $S^3$, and the family is Morse–Bott nondegenerate with small eigenvalues $\pm\sqrt{10| ar
u|/3}\,(1+O( ar
u))$ and $0^{(3)}$. For $ ar
u>0$ the solutions are exactly the isotropic $k_\pm$, and $Rk_+=k_-$.
(D) The reduced field has an explicit strict Lyapunov function $H=\int_0^x\dot x\,dx$, valid to all orders. Hence near the fold the only HW trajectories are constants and, for $ ar
u>0$, the AH instanton; there is none from $k_-$ to $k_+$. A fixed ball is isolating uniformly through $ ar
u=0$, and its Conley homology is $\mathbb Z$ in degrees $1,4$. So the index $-3=-\dim S^3$ of [20] is the shadow of $\mathcal S_{ ar
u}$.

change_summary: Section 6 rewritten: the W-increase/last-exit argument is replaced by an explicit strict Lyapunov function H = int_0^x f_x for the full reduced field (Proposition 6.2, dH/dt = f_x^2 + x^2|w|^2 m with m(0)=25/16), using the exact planar reduction from SO(4)-equivariance and reversibility (Lemma 6.1, Hadamard's lemma), LaSalle's principle, no-return via strictness, and a uniform isolating neighbourhood through nu=0; Conley conclusions derived from that isolated invariant set (attractor-repeller sequence, Thom-space index). Theorem A corrected: tangency only in the centre variables; d_nu Psi(0,0) = Psi_mu/pi^2 != 0 stated explicitly; new Lemma 2.2 introduces the affine shift xi = mu Psi_mu + xi~ (as in math_24 v2, Lemma 5.2 and correction remark), compatible with SO(4) and the reversor; hypotheses of Haragus-Iooss Ch. 2 Thm 2.20 and Thm 3.3 listed for the shifted system; citation changed to math_24 v2. Clarifications: Euclidean metric at the origin vs induced metric; vector-field vs potential coefficients (Remark 4.1: kappa = beta = 0 as coefficients of H, which is odd in x); 'reduced' unstable normal direction; Conley homology distinguished from a Morse-Smale complex (no perturbation; connection matrix zero by degree); Remark 6.3 on the HW energy functional (not used). verify.py: new section 7b (exact Lyapunov identity for a general reversible equivariant field with symbolic higher-order terms, oddness of H, H = W + O_5, H(k+)<0<H(k-), R Psi_mu = Psi_mu, shifted forcing in PX); 65 checks, FALLOS = 0. verify.mpl: real-zero counting by explicit cases with type(evalf(z), realcons); new Lyapunov block; 29 checks (not run). Added section 8 'Changes from the first submission'; references to Haydys and LaSalle added.
title: A reversible five-dimensional centre-manifold reduction at the Anderson–Henningson fold: a three-sphere of non-isotropic Kapustin–Witten solutions below the fold
